Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting adult day care services from certain regulations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adult day care services; amending RCW70.128.030; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that adult day careservices can provide a needed service to individuals who find itdifficult to care for themselves in their own residences during theday. The legislature intends that families be able to care for theirfamily members with disabilities at home and that neighbors helpneighbors with this care without permission from the government. Adultday care can assist family members in providing continuous communitybased care for their family members with disabilities and reduce theneed for more expensive nursing and other residential facility care.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.128.030 and 1989 c 427 s 17 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following residential facilities shall be exempt from theoperation of this chapter: (1) Nursing homes licensed under chapter 18.51 RCW; (2) Boarding homes licensed under chapter 18.20 RCW; p. 1 SB 5976 (3) Facilities approved and certified under chapter 71A.22 RCW; (4) Residential treatment centers for the mentally ill licensedunder chapter 71.24 RCW; (5) Hospitals licensed under chapter 70.41 RCW; (6) Homes for the developmentally disabled licensed under chapter74.15 RCW; (7) Adult day care homes which are regular private family abodes inwhich the home owner is the resident manager and primary care giver,and provides care to no more than five adults during the day and doesnot provide overnight care.
